title: Graphs of Hecke operators in mixed ramification
summary: We study Hecke operators on moduli spaces of ramified $G$-bundles using the combinatorial language of Hecke graphs. We introduce a general notion of $\mathcal H$-ramification in the spirit of parahoric ramification, which depends on a choice of a divisor and subgroups of $G$ at every point of the divisor. Building on our previous work, we prove that, under mild regularity conditions, the action of a Hecke operator in the deep cusp of $\mathrm{Bun}_G$ in a highly complex ramification mimics an action in a much simpler ramification.
